input.query: Research and analyze current best practices in autonomous AI development methodologies for 2024-2026. Focus on: (1) System architecture patterns that enable genuine autonomy, (2) Memory and persistence strategies for continuous learning, (3) Multi-agent coordination approaches, (4) Self-modification and adaptive capabilities, and (5) Evaluation metrics for autonomous intelligence. Provide actionable insights for implementing these methodologies.
